title: Volatility target, 10 percent a year
author: arhancanli
rationale: Holds less when recent volatility is high and more when it is low, aiming for a steady level of risk. Volatility tends to cluster, so the recent past says something about the near future.
risks: It sells after volatility has already jumped, and a sudden fall arrives before it can react. Using leverage in calm markets adds to the loss when calm ends, and frequent changes add costs.
references: Moreira and Muir (2017), Volatility-Managed Portfolios, Journal of Finance
